headline: Quality Control Engineer

skill_groups.label: Communication
items: reports to project managers and clients

summary: Licensed civil engineer with five years in construction quality control around Subic and Olongapo. I write inspection and test plans, run material tests, lead a QC team on site and audit contractors against plans and specifications. I have kept two large projects free of major quality findings from the client.

experience.title: Quality Control Engineer
bullets: Lead a QC team of four on warehouse and port-facility projects worth ₱1.2 billion.
Prepare inspection and test plans and check concrete, rebar and soil test results.
Audit subcontractors' work against the plans and specifications and track corrective actions.
Keep the project's ISO 9001 quality records ready for client audits.

experience.title: Site QA/QC Inspector
bullets: Inspected formworks, rebar and concrete pours and recorded measurements.
Reported safety and quality issues on site to the project engineer.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering
